call_purpose: Leads were coming in from your form, but the autoresponder email was not being sent to them.

resolved.text: Following our guidance, you turned on the autoresponder option in your form settings and saved it; a test form filled in from your other email address then delivered the email, and you confirmed it is working correctly now.

covered.text: We explained that emails can sometimes go to spam, so verifying your sender domain is a good idea, and that you can do this in the email domain part of the settings. This is not yet done.

customer_next_steps.text: Verify your sender domain in the email domain part of the settings.
customer_next_steps.timeline: कल सुबह (the morning after the call)
